shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat upright slab
repeated motifs arranged in horizontal registers/rows
stylized animal or plant forms in profile
justification: Both are flat upright slabs bearing low relief with motifs organized in repeated rows, but A depicts a menagerie of animals — a row of crouching quadrupeds under a hatched band, a large predator/bird facing a small human-like figure, and a long-necked bird below — while B shows only a repeating vegetal pattern of stylized palmette/lotus-like flowers linked by curling stems with rosettes at the edge. Beyond the generic idea of registered relief with repeated units there is no shared creature, object or relationship.
